# src/blender/tests Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/add-readme.md-for-test-files-2025-06-22


This folder hosts unit tests, benchmarks, and helper mocks for the Blender integration. The suite predates the top-level `tests/` directory and should eventually be consolidated there.

## Files and Actions

| File | Usefulness | Move/Remove |
| ---- | ---------- | ----------- |
| `CMakeLists.txt` | Build rules for the suite. | Move once tests are relocated. |
| `api_test.cpp` | Exercises the public C API used by Blender scripts. | Move |
| `compression_test.cpp` | Validates pattern compression utilities. | Move |
| `connection_pool_manager_test.cpp` | Tests the generic connection manager. | Move to `tests/api` |
| `gpu_context_test.cpp` | Covers GPUContext initialization and memory operations. | Move |
| `gpu_context_perf_test.cpp` | Measures GPUContext performance. | Move |
| `mesh_handler_test.cpp` | Checks MeshHandler logic and metrics. | Move |
| `mesh_handler_perf_test.cpp` | Performance suite for MeshHandler. | Move |
| `mesh_handler_stress_test.cpp` | Stress tests with large meshes. | Move |
| `mesh_handler_benchmark.cpp` | Google Benchmark harness for MeshHandler. | Move |
| `pattern_data_test.cpp` | Ensures correct GPU pattern data layout. | Move |
| `scene_load_test.cpp` | Loads JSON scenes from `scenes/`. | Move |
| `run_tests.sh` / `run_all_tests.sh` | Convenience scripts for building and executing the suite. | Remove after migration |
| `mocks/` | Mock implementations used by the tests. | Move |
| `scenes/` | Sample scene descriptions. | Move |

All tests are currently useful and compile, so none should be discarded. After relocating them to the central `tests/` directory the original folder can be removed.
